Simple and quick Onion Tomato Gravy for Chapati/roti

Author: Kalyani but heavily modified

Onions
- 2 large sized
Tomatoes
- 3 medium sized
Green
chillies - 1 big fresh Osnan chilli
Coriander
powder - 1/2 teaspoon
Cumin
powder - 1/2 teaspoon
Allspice
powder -1/4 tsp
Garlic
- a lot of cloves
Celery
Salt - to taste

Mustard
seeds- 1 teaspoon
Onion
seeds - 1 teaspoon
Oil
and ghee for frying

Method:-
Chop the onions, tomatoes, garlic and green chillies.
Heat a pan with oil and the items to temper. Once the mustard seeds cracks add onions.
Fry the onions till it becomes transparent.
After that add the tomatoes in and sauté till mushy.
Once the tomatoes are warm add the other ingredients.
Mix well and fry in low flame for 5 minutes.
Add ¼ cup of water or stock and cook covered until the tomatoes are well cooked. Then keep the flame low, cook the gravy till the desired consistency is reached.
If necessary add beans with the tomatoes to make a different mix.
